prompt:
Use case: premium Logo + VI brand-kit image.
Primary request: Create a refined derivative of Lotus direction 1: dark developer-tool kernel. Lotus is a global AGENTS.md rules and skills installer for Codex and Claude Code. This version should be executive, polished, production-ready, and more premium than a first concept.
Subject: Complete brand identity board with simple vector-like Lotus logo mark, clear wordmark "Lotus", palette, typography, app icon, terminal command card, AGENTS.md documentation card, and UI mockup.
Style: high-end developer tool identity, charcoal canvas, off-white panels, precise grid, calm engineering authority, subtle technical texture, premium brand guidelines deck.
Composition: 16:10 horizontal 3x3 board, one large central logo panel, mark construction, palette/type, app icon, UI, documentation and skill sync cards.
Text: "Lotus" must appear clearly as the main brand name. Keep other text minimal and label-like.
Constraints: logo should feel like a calm execution kernel made from lotus petal geometry; simple enough for favicon, app icon, README badge.
Avoid: random unreadable text, generic flower clipart, messy moodboard, cheap gradients, watermark, low-resolution artifacts.

Use case: premium Logo + VI brand-kit image.
Primary request: Create a refined derivative of Lotus direction 3: signal bloom and skill routing. Lotus routes global rules, skills, and runtime capabilities across AI coding hosts. This version should feel like mature AI infrastructure.
Subject: Complete brand identity board with node-based Lotus logo mark, clear wordmark "Lotus", palette, typography, app icon, network routing UI panel, skill cards, runtime sync touchpoints.
Style: high-end AI infrastructure identity, dark teal system, luminous but controlled cyan/amber accents, clean vector mark, precise premium grid.
Composition: 16:10 horizontal 3x3 board, central logo and wordmark, node construction panel, color/type panel, UI mockup, app icon, documentation and skill application examples.
Text: "Lotus" must appear clearly as the main brand name. Other text minimal and readable.
Constraints: logo should abstract lotus petals into connected nodes and routing paths, but remain simple and ownable.
Avoid: generic neural network sphere, sci-fi clutter, overglow, random unreadable text, messy collage, watermark.

Use case: premium Logo + VI brand-kit image.
Primary request: Create a second refined derivative of Lotus direction 3: signal bloom / skill routing, but brighter, cleaner, and more product-friendly. Lotus is a modern AI-agent operating layer for shared rules and skills.
Subject: Complete brand identity board with simple lotus-node logo mark, clear wordmark "Lotus", bright color palette, typography, app icon, clean product UI mockup, skill route diagram, documentation card.
Style: modern AI product identity, white and deep teal panels, crisp cyan, lime, and amber accents, approachable but still technical, premium SaaS brand guidelines deck.
Composition: 16:10 horizontal board, clean grid, large logo panel, construction diagram, palette/type, app icon, UI, skill route and docs touchpoints.
Text: "Lotus" must appear clearly as the main brand name. Minimal readable labels only.
Constraints: logo must be simple and small-size friendly; routing metaphor should be clear but not noisy.
Avoid: noisy cyberpunk, generic nodes, unreadable paragraphs, watermark, low-res artifacts.
